## Activity

During April 2019, North City Eye Clinic recorded 470 captures. Capture activity was maintained across the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 0.6. This represents a small proportion of the total activity. The ungradable results should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality review, with attention to any recurring issues affecting image acquisition.

## Grading

A total of 79 results were graded referable during April 2019. The median grading lag was 7 days. These figures should be considered alongside the capture volume and image-quality results when reviewing site performance. Overall, the report records the month’s activity, the number of ungradable captures and the grading outcomes for North City Eye Clinic.
